confirmed_bugs.title: Canvas bridge trusts a forwarded scheme despite its setting
confirmed_bugs.expected: With trust_forwarded_headers disabled, X-Forwarded-Proto should not alter an otherwise valid request.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The same session bootstrap succeeds without the header and returns 421 when X-Forwarded-Proto: https is supplied.

confirmed_bugs.title: Canvas bare-root query parameter changes the proxied path
confirmed_bugs.expected: ?path=echo on the bare app root should reach the root with the query unchanged.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The proxy sends the request to /echo, whereas the trailing-slash root preserves /.

confirmed_bugs.title: Canvas proxy sends duplicate Date and Server headers
confirmed_bugs.expected: A proxied response should contain one Date and one Server header.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Uvicorn adds its headers alongside copied backend headers, producing comma-joined duplicate values.

confirmed_bugs.title: Canvas WebSocket bridge loses requested subprotocol
confirmed_bugs.expected: The bridge should negotiate qa.v1 exactly as the directly contacted backend does.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The direct socket selects qa.v1; the proxied socket selects no protocol and reports protocol none, breaking browser clients that require a subprotocol.

confirmed_bugs.title: Canvas bridge keeps crashed backend ready until status polling
confirmed_bugs.expected: After the backend process exits, requests should return 503 backend not ready.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Without a status poll, requests return 502 Conversation container unreachable for the entire 15-second observation.

confirmed_bugs.title: OpenAI continuation usage includes previous turns
confirmed_bugs.expected: The second request should report its own 3 prompt, 2 completion and 5 total tokens.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It reports accumulated 13 prompt, 7 completion and 20 total tokens although per-call usage is available.

confirmed_bugs.title: Overlapping OpenAI requests receive the later turn's answer
confirmed_bugs.expected: Request X should receive its stored QA_F30_RACE_B answer; request Y should receive QA_F30_RACE_C.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Both requests receive QA_F30_RACE_C although the server stores the correct separate B and C agent messages.

confirmed_bugs.title: OpenAI continuation waits 120 seconds at confirmation
confirmed_bugs.expected: A continued conversation awaiting confirmation should return 409 promptly, like a new one.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It remains waiting_for_confirmation with the proposed command unrun, then returns 504 after the fixed 120-second gateway timeout.

confirmed_bugs.title: Rejected OpenAI continuations persist duplicate user turns
confirmed_bugs.expected: A 429 should leave the conversation unchanged so an OpenAI retry is safe.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Each refused request appends the user message; two 429 responses leave two copies.

confirmed_bugs.title: Second-server takeover overwrites newer conversation metadata
confirmed_bugs.expected: The title last persisted by the first owner should survive takeover.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The second server rewrites meta.json with its startup catalog's older title, losing the owner's later rename.
notes: Isolated copied recipe adjusts only exited-zombie setup observation; frozen product source and bug assertion unchanged. See F31-zombie-adaptation.md.

confirmed_bugs.title: Rejected stale-owner write changes its GET state and returns 500
confirmed_bugs.expected: A lost-ownership PATCH should give a client error and leave visible state unchanged.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The guarded save refuses the write and disk remains correct, but the stale owner's GET reports the refused title; PATCH returns 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: Explicit environment null cannot clear a configured value
confirmed_bugs.expected: OH_APP_BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL_IS_NONE=1 should clear the URL and capability even when the config file sets it.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The file's URL remains advertised because merge keeps an earlier value when the environment supplies None. The same behavior prevents environment-based disabling of a configured idle TTL.

confirmed_bugs.title: Server-selected per-process tmux directory survives shutdown
confirmed_bugs.expected: The per-process TMUX_TMPDIR selected by the server should disappear after graceful stop.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The directory remains; the recipe's cleanup trap removes it after recording the failed assertion.
notes: Isolated copied recipe adjusts only exited-zombie setup observation; frozen product source and bug assertion unchanged. See F31-zombie-adaptation.md.

confirmed_bugs.title: Full webhook buffer waits behind an in-flight batch
confirmed_bugs.expected: The queued user message should reach the sink within ten seconds once the buffer fills.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The first batch is posted, while a second full buffer waits for the long flush timer or a later close.

confirmed_bugs.title: Webhook schema documents the wrong event path and timer
confirmed_bugs.expected: OpenAPI should describe the per-conversation event path and a timer started by the first event.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It says events go to /events and the timer resets with every new event; live behavior differs.

confirmed_bugs.title: Slow webhook causes 409 after the conversation reports finished
confirmed_bugs.expected: A finished conversation should accept a new run regardless of receiver latency.
confirmed_bugs.actual: A fast receiver permits POST /run; a 15-second receiver makes it return 409 Conversation already running while GET says finished.

confirmed_bugs.title: Conversation outcome telemetry misses real token and cost usage
confirmed_bugs.expected: A real model run's outcome should contain measured usage buckets.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The conversation has positive token usage but outcome total_tokens_bucket and cost_bucket are unknown.

confirmed_bugs.title: Telemetry schema promises a random fallback instead of secret key
confirmed_bugs.expected: The salt description should state that the configured secret key is the first fallback.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It promises per-process random salt and unlinkability across runs although the secret-key-derived reference remains stable across restarts.

confirmed_bugs.title: Python remote conversations ignore token callbacks
confirmed_bugs.expected: Token callbacks should receive streamed deltas supplied to the remote conversation.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Event callbacks see deltas, but the token callback is never called.

confirmed_bugs.title: Python remote state stores transient token deltas
confirmed_bugs.expected: state.events should exclude transient StreamingDeltaEvent frames and match stored server history.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The client adds streamed deltas to state.events although the server persists none.

confirmed_bugs.title: Reading Python remote state twice corrupts its cached values
confirmed_bugs.expected: Repeated reads of confirmation policy, analyzer, agent and confirmation-mode flag should remain stable.
confirmed_bugs.actual: First reads are correct; second policy/agent reads raise ValidationError, analyzer becomes None and confirmation mode changes true to false.

confirmed_bugs.title: Python run join times out during a healthy long tool call
confirmed_bugs.expected: A second run() should join the 45-second tool call and return finished.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It raises ConversationRunError wrapping ReadTimeout after 30 seconds while the original run continues, writes its file and finishes.

confirmed_bugs.title: Python reconnect reconciles history but skips missed callbacks
confirmed_bugs.expected: A user message recorded during the socket outage should reach callbacks after reconnection.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Both messages appear in server history and state.events; only the connected message reaches the callback.

confirmed_bugs.title: Unimportable custom tool produces an unhandled server error
confirmed_bugs.expected: A client tool the server cannot import should result in a 4xx or a recorded conversation error.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Creation succeeds with 201, then sending the message fails with 500 for the unregistered tool.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript RemoteWorkspace corrupts binary downloads
confirmed_bugs.expected: The five-byte file ff 00 80 fe 41 should download byte for byte with file_size 5.
confirmed_bugs.actual: FileClient returns the exact bytes; RemoteWorkspace produces eleven bytes ef bf bd 00 ef bf bd ef bf bd 41 and file_size 11.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript GitChange status type disagrees with server values
confirmed_bugs.expected: Statuses returned by gitChanges should type-check against exported GitChange.status.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The server values UPDATED and ADDED type-check against generated GitChangeStatus but fail against the exported lowercase union.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript BashWebSocketClient cannot open a Node socket
confirmed_bugs.expected: The Node callback should receive the BashOutput that the CLI replays on the same socket.
confirmed_bugs.actual: No frames arrive and onError says WebSocket implementation not available because the ESM module attempts require('ws').
notes: Two driving bullets share the ESM WebSocket constructor discovery failure and are counted as one defect.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript event lookup receives 500 for a missing event
confirmed_bugs.expected: A missing event should reject with 404 and batch lookup should return null in that slot.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Single and batch calls both reject with 500 Unknown event_id. This is the server defect also exercised by F06.unknown-event.
notes: Same server defect as F06.unknown-event; cross-family aggregate must deduplicate.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript documented short event kinds find no events
confirmed_bugs.expected: MessageEvent should find the same queued user message as the fully qualified kind.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The qualified kind finds one; the short name returns no items and count zero. Same server root cause as F06.search-kind-short.
notes: Same server defect as F06.search-kind-short; cross-family aggregate must deduplicate.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript updateConversation return type promises missing fields
confirmed_bugs.expected: The declared ConversationInfo result should include the conversation id and stored new title.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The title is stored, but the promise resolves with success:true and its id/title are undefined.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript manager ignores conversation execution options
confirmed_bugs.expected: maxIterations 7 and stuckDetection false should be preserved, like direct RemoteConversation.start.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The manager-created conversation has max_iterations 500 and stuck_detection true.
